name: The Girl and the Demon
source:
The girl and the demon tells a story of a young demon boy called Theo who struggles with his decision of what he wants to do when he grows up. Upon arriving to the human world with his classmates, he gets lost from his group and ends up in a snowy forest. There he meets a little girl who mistakes Theo for her imaginary friend. Soon Theo has to make a decision of whether or not he is going to answer his calling. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909033511/https://tettere.co.vu/post/82920164602/download-from-here-should-support]official site[/url]]
translation:
《女孩与恶魔》讲述年轻恶魔男孩西奥的故事，他苦恼于长大后想做什么。和同学来到人类世界后，他与队伍走散，最终来到一片雪林。在那里，他遇到一个把西奥误认为幻想朋友的小女孩。很快，西奥必须决定是否响应自己的使命。
